programmes.d: A man (Eason Chan) develops a relationship with a mysterious woman (Shu Qi) who sees ghosts.

programmes.d: Classically trained actor Robert Englund becomes a horror icon with his portrayal of Freddy Krueger, the burned, razor-clawed boogeyman in the "Nightmare on Elm Street" franchise.
The warden of a 2022 prison sends an ex-Marine (Ray Liotta) to a jungle island where inmates are left to die.
